title: Account Administrator's Guide to Buyer Limits, Approval Thresholds and Purchase Orders — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
On Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms), the terms tier sets how many authorized buyers may order on the account, the default per-order limit of each authorized buyer, the order total above which the account administrator must approve the order, and whether every invoiced order must carry a purchase order number.

| Terms tier | Most authorized buyers on the account | Default per-order limit of an authorized buyer (USD) | Administrator approval needed for an order total above (USD) | Purchase order number required on every invoiced order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 5 | 500 | 1000 | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 10 | 1000 | 2500 | No |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 25 | 2500 | 5000 | No |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 50 | 5000 | 10000 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 200 | 10000 | 25000 | Yes |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 50 | 2500 | 5000 | Yes |

### For the account administrator

- **Buyer limit.** The per-order figure is each authorized buyer's default limit; it applies unless the administrator sets otherwise.
- **Approval threshold.** The figure is an order total above which the administrator must approve the order. An order total equal to the figure is not above it.
- **Purchase orders.** On Net 45 Volume, Net 60 Enterprise and Net 30 Public Sector every invoiced order must carry a purchase order number; on Net 15, Net 30 Standard and Net 30 Preferred it is not required.

### Threshold illustration (hypothetical order totals, Net 30 Standard)

| Hypothetical order total | Above the $2500 approval threshold? |
|---|---|
| $2499.00 | No |
| $2500.00 | No |
| $2500.01 | Yes |
